messages:
maria: Heads-up — cutoff is T+3h. We need a final decision on the version bump and whether we include the last-minute telemetry fix. I think v1.6.0 is fine if nothing else pops.
kevin: I can cut the tag once QA gives final ✅. Which branch should I tag from? main or release/v1.6?
sam: Tag from release/v1.6 — that's where the docs and changelog edits landed. I pushed a tiny fix for the changelog script, see commit 8f3a. If anyone needs a cherry-pick: `git cherry-pick 8f3a --no-commit`.
anish: Quick FYI — our flaky e2e is failing in the Windows runner (intermittent timeout). QA is re-running the matrix now. If the flaky test fails again we should opt to skip it for this release and file a follow-up.
sara-docs: Docs are ready on release/v1.6. I left a small note in the changelog entry about the telemetry fix — needs confirmation whether it should go under "bugfix" or "internal".
kevin: Can someone paste the exact CHANGELOG fragment we want? I'll include it in the tag message.
maria: Use this for the changelog entry:
```
### v1.6.0 (rc)
- Fix: reduce telemetry batch size to avoid data spikes (sam)
- Improve: config validation for private deploys (kevin)
- Docs: update versioning guide for dedicated capacity (sara-docs)
```
maria: Also, policy check — is security review green? We had a late dependency warning yesterday.
anish: Security had one high-severity dependency flagged in the SDK but we've got a patch in staging. Reviewer @sec-team said patch looks fine but wants a short mitigation note in release notes. I'll ping them again.
release-bot: Release cutoff in 2h. Reminder: all PRs must be merged and CI green to proceed. Use `/release ready` when set.
qa-bot: QA run started — 18 tests failing, mostly flakes. Rerun 1 triggered by @anish.
sam: If QA still shows flakes in 1h, propose we proceed with the following checklist:
- Skip flaky test(s) with a tracked Jira
- Confirm security mitigation note is added to changelog
- Tag release from release/v1.6 and push `v1.6.0-rc.1`
- Start canary with 5% traffic, monitor token cost and latency for 30m
kevin: Agreed. I'll prepare the tag command now:
```
git checkout release/v1.6
git pull origin release/v1.6
git tag -a v1.6.0-rc.1 -m "v1.6.0-rc.1 — preflight"
git push origin v1.6.0-rc.1
```
sara-docs: I'll add the mitigation note to the changelog (short line) and push a docs-only PR to release/v1.6.
anish: Security said they'll give final thumbs-up in ~45m if the patched dependency lands — otherwise they want the mitigation note and a monitored rollout.
maria: Ok — plan: if QA is green in 1h and security either OK or mitigation note is present, we tag and start canary. If QA still flaky, schedule a hotfix for next weekday and hold the release.
kevin: I'll stand by for `/release ready`. Ping me here when you're good and I'll create the tag.
release-bot: Received `/release ready` from @maria at 2143658000. Queued for tagging.
maria: Great — thanks everyone. Small asks: please double-check changelog capitalization and keep PR descriptions short. I'll update the ship doc with final steps.
qa-bot: QA rerun: now 2 failing tests (both known flakes). Flagged as flaky and created ticket RB-742.
sam: With the flaky ticket in place and the security mitigation note added, I'm 👍 for tagging.
kevin: Tag pushed: `v1.6.0-rc.1` -> origin. Starting canary 5% now.
maria: Launching canary monitor. I'll watch latency and top token spend for 30m, pinging here for any anomalies.
anish: Security final note: mitigation mention in changelog is fine, Sec will follow up post-canary. Good to go from my side.
sara-docs: Docs PR merged to release/v1.6.
maria: Closing preflight in this thread — follow-ups: RB-742 (flake), RB-743 (post-canary security audit). Thanks :rocket:
